description: MtaStsEnforcer uses Mutex<HashMap<String,(CachedStsEntry,Instant)>>. Every restart discards all cached policies. On startup all outbound deliveries will trigger a live DNS + HTTPS fetch before the first delivery to each domain. Under high restart rate this creates load on remote policy servers and adds latency on every post-restart delivery burst. The deleted DB migration suggests the DB-backed design was the intended fix. This is not a bug but is a design gap that should be documented as a known limitation (or the DB cache should be wired in).
title: MtaStsEnforcer in-memory cache lost on restart — enforcer design note
